description: Find an economy to start from. With `query` (the person’s own words, as they said them), returns the closest worked examples (whole specs that check and go live in the tests), the closest of 112 real or trending economies rated against loot (great / some / a-lot / cannot, with what carries it or what is missing), and what loot can’t do exactly in the ask, each with the nearest versions it can. Call it again with the words of any part that looks impossible: the answer is a nearest version to offer, not a dead end. With `name`, returns that example’s whole spec to copy and change. With neither, lists every example.

name.description: An example’s name, to get its whole spec.

query.description: What the person wants, in a few words.

name: xsolana_examples
